title: forge check data
description: Payload of `forge check --json`: every file checked and every diagnostic found across the resolver, the checkers and the boundary pass. `warnings` in the envelope repeats the warnings-only findings; `status` is `error` when any diagnostic is an error, `warning` when there are warnings but no errors.

files.description: Paths as given on the command line, in order.

diagnostics.description: Empty on a clean check; codes are stable (`forge explain <code>`).
